Who is Adderly Fong?

Adderly Fong ( 方 駿宇 born 2 March 1990) is a Hong Kong driver who was a test driver for in the 2014 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, before becoming a development driver for in this story — part of Formula 1.

Adderly Fong's first taste of a Formula One car was the Sauber C33 at the 2014 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix. He set the 19th fastest time in the first Free Practice session.
